messages.subject: Troubles with Inset
parts:
Dear All,
I am trying to generate a plot with an inset, but I am experiencing
troubles.
Following the example at

http://bit.ly/aulhaq

I tried running the following snippet as a test

library(ggplot2)

theme_bw(10)

cp <- qplot(uempmed, unemploy, data = economics, geom="path", log="y")
bp <- qplot(uempmed, unemploy, data = economics, log="xy") +
geom_smooth(se = F)

pdf("polishing-subplot-bw.pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
subvp <- viewport(width = 0.4, height = 0.4, x = 0.75, y = 0.35)
bp
print(cp, vp = subvp)
dev.off()

but this does not produce on my machine (ubuntu 10.04, amd64, ggplot2
version 0.8.8) the plot attached to Hadley's reply in the thread above
(I see only the inset).
Is there anything I am misunderstanding about insets and ggplot2?
Any help is really appreciated.
Cheers

Lorenzo
